fusions.name: Buckled Ground
fusions.desc: Roots heave the ground flat around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Deadfall Bough
fusions.desc: Brings a felled bough down on one enemy, dealing 32 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tamped Earth
fusions.desc: Packs the earth into a slab around you that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattened Thicket
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
